governance_principle: Newly added metrics are DESCRIPTIVE and are NOT promoted into frozen prospective success/failure gates. Formal H3 adjudication continues to use the previously frozen criteria.

segmentation.form: 2x2 pixel confusion matrix (Background / Foreground) in BOTH raw counts and row-normalized form
segmentation.source_requirement: actual pixel predictions versus actual GT masks only; never derived from aggregated Dice
segmentation.explicit_caveat: accuracy, specificity and ROC-AUC must NOT be presented alone as evidence of segmentation quality under class imbalance

component_detection.form: TP / FP / FN summary + PR / FROC
component_detection.reason: conventional TN is undefined without a defensible negative-unit definition

proposal_localization.form: matched / unmatched proposal and GT accounting

label_rule: Never use the same short label (e.g. 'Recall') across domains without explicit qualification.
distance_unit_rule: No pixel-spacing metadata exists in this repository; boundary distances are reported in PIXELS, never mm.
